t_advice_summary_textbox.text: to mainly go based on instinct, although the taller gnomes might give more points and the basket colour might matter

vb_textbox.text: I think it's roughly 50/50 and doesn't really matter, but I felt the tall pink, purple and blue gnomes gave more, and the short green gnome gave more. At the end I started trying to make my choice as quickly as possible (pressing as soon as the gnomes appeared) and I didn't get 0 at all in my last 25-30 goes, so reaction time might also be important.
